description: Decode observed RC250 preset changes using the persistent hardware cursor. Modulo-five adjacent transitions identify left/right, including wrap. Ignore paired brightness actions and duplicates; resynchronize ambiguous jumps without guessing. Cursor updates precede room commands and survive lighting override resets.

actions.value_template: {{ payload is mapping and payload.get('action')=='color_temperature_move' and payload.get('action_color_temperature') is number and payload.get('action_color_temperature') is not boolean and payload.get('action_color_temperature') in presets }}
{{ delta in [1,4] and room is string and room|length>0 }}
